name: Shimai Ijiri ~Chiru Hana, Nirin~
original_name: 姉妹いじり ～散ル花、二輪～
source:
Our guy is ordered to train two sisters for a high price sale. Training them is easy as giving them experience, but will he fall in love with one or both while doing it?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
我们的家伙奉命训练两个姐妹以高价出售。训练他们很容易，就像给他们经验一样，但他会在做的过程中爱上其中一个还是两个？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]李的欢乐屋[/url]]
